we found that changes in functional residual capacity (helium dilution technique) were a good indicator of changes in airway caliber in young asthmatics.
we have demonstrated that changes in FCR can be used to assess the bronchodilator response in young asthmatic subjects, and that this response may be different from that observed in older subjects.

FRC is not a good test for bronchodilator response, and that it is not a good predictor of response to bronchodilation.
